title: Modal - Sample Site
description: Demonstration of the functional and component APIs for ui-modal.

en.hero_desc: Demonstrates the Modal API with semantic methods: success(), info(), error(), and confirm().
en.semantic_desc: Use Modal.success(), Modal.info(), Modal.error(), or Modal.confirm() for common use cases
en.single_arg_desc: When only one argument is provided, it is treated as the message (title becomes empty)
en.info_message: This is some important information for you.
en.error_message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
en.confirm_message: Are you sure you want to proceed?
en.delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete this item? This action cannot be undone.
en.unsaved_message: You have unsaved changes. Do you want to discard them?
